ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The map is marked with “Danjiangkou Reservoir”; the reservoir is located in the lower-left part of the map; there are relatively thick administrative boundary lines in the map separating different provincial-level regions, and there are also several arrows distributed around the reservoir and its nearby areas, indicating the directions of population movement. Most arrows are concentrated within the same provincial-level range around Danjiangkou Reservoir, and the movement directions are mostly short-distance movements between nearby areas. Reasoning: Observing the arrows one by one, the vast majority of arrows do not cross the relatively thick provincial boundary lines in the map, but move within the same provincial-level administrative region around Danjiangkou Reservoir; even if individual arrows are close to the provincial boundary, they are not the main body. Therefore, it is judged that this kind of population migration mainly belongs to intra-provincial migration.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的行政边界和箭头位置，再逐一判断箭头是否穿过省界。若绝大部分箭头只是在丹江口水库周边的同一省级范围内移动，只有少数或没有箭头跨过省界，就得出这种人口迁移主要是省内迁移。
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中标有“丹江口水库”，水库位于图的下部偏左；图内有较粗的行政边界线分隔不同省级区域，另有若干箭头分布在水库周边及其附近地区，表示人口移动方向。多数箭头集中在丹江口水库周边的同一省级范围内，移动方向多为附近区域之间的短距离移动。
推理：按箭头逐一观察，绝大多数箭头没有穿过图中较粗的省界线，而是在丹江口水库周边同一省级行政区内部移动；即使个别箭头接近省界，也不是主体。由此判断，这种人口迁移主要属于省内迁移。

planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 地理判读规则：省内迁移指人口移动起点和终点在同一省级行政区内；跨省迁移则应明显穿越省界。若图上多数箭头未穿越省界，则判断为多为省内迁移。

Therefore, it is judged that this kind of population migration mainly belongs to intra-provincial migration.
